mapper.select: SELECT l.id,l.leg_type type,l.charge_mode mode,l.leg_status status,l.pricing_snapshot_json snapshot,f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen pool FROM order_transport_leg l JOIN rental_order_freight_account f ON f.rental_order_id=l.rental_order_id WHERE l.rental_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY l.leg_type
mapper.sql: s.id,s.rental_order_id order_id,o.order_no,s.factory_id, (SELECT MIN(i.factory_name_snapshot) FROM checkout_batch_item_snapshot i WHERE i.checkout_batch_id=o.checkout_batch_id AND i.factory_id=s.factory_id) factory_name, s.statement_version,s.version,s.review_status status,s.outbound_transport_leg_id outbound_id,s.return_transport_leg_id return_id, s.outbound_execution_source outbound_source,s.return_execution_source return_source,s.outbound_carrier_name outbound_carrier,s.outbound_carrier_order_no outbound_order_no, s.return_carrier_name return_carrier,s.return_carrier_order_no return_order_no,s.outbound_declared_base_amount_fen outbound_base,s.return_declared_base_amount_fen return_base, s.outbound_declared_total_amount_fen outbound_total,s.return_declared_total_amount_fen return_total,s.outbound_approved_amount_fen approved_outbound,s.return_approved_amount_fen approved_return, s.declared_total_amount_fen declared_total,s.approved_total_amount_fen approved_total,s.prepaid_pool_amount_fen pool,s.online_settle_amount_fen online, s.over_budget_amount_fen over_budget,s.refundable_amount_fen refundable,s.evidence_count,s.extra_fee_detail_json detail_json,s.submitted_at,s.reviewed_at,s.review_reason reason, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(r.id) FROM refund_order r WHERE r.rental_order_id=o.id AND r.refund_type='freight_pool_release' AND s.review_status='approved') refund_json, a.charge_mode outbound_mode,b.charge_mode return_mode,a.pricing_snapshot_json outbound_snapshot,b.pricing_snapshot_json return_snapshot,a.leg_status outbound_status,b.leg_status return_status, NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_transport_expense_statement later WHERE later.rental_order_id=s.rental_order_id AND later.statement_version>s.statement_version) latest_version

FROM order_transport_expense_statement s JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=s.rental_order_id JOIN order_transport_leg a ON a.id=s.outbound_transport_leg_id JOIN order_transport_leg b ON b.id=s.return_transport_leg_id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE s.rental_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY s.statement_version DESC LIMIT 1

where.if: AND (LOCATE(#{query.keyword},o.order_no)>0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rental_order_item i WHERE i.rental_order_id=o.id AND LOCATE(#{query.keyword},i.prop_name_snapshot)>0))

mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY s.created_at DESC,s.statement_version DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT #{query.page.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.page.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_transport_expense_statement s JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=s.rental_order_id

SELECT e.id,e.transport_leg_id leg_id,e.evidence_scene scene,e.transport_expense_statement_id statement_id FROM order_evidence_record e JOIN order_transport_expense_statement s ON s.rental_order_id=e.rental_order_id AND s.id=#{id} WHERE e.rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND e.evidence_node='transport_expense' AND e.evidence_type='photo' AND e.draft_removed_at IS NULL AND (e.transport_expense_statement_id=s.id OR JSON_CONTAINS(s.extra_fee_detail_json,JSON_QUOTE(e.id),'$.reusedEvidenceIds')) ORDER BY e.id
mapper.update: UPDATE order_transport_expense_statement SET outbound_execution_source=#{draft.outbound.source},return_execution_source=#{draft.returnLeg.source}, outbound_carrier_name=#{draft.outbound.carrier},return_carrier_name=#{draft.returnLeg.carrier},outbound_carrier_order_no=#{draft.outbound.orderNo},return_carrier_order_no=#{draft.returnLeg.orderNo}, outbound_declared_base_amount_fen=#{draft.outbound.base},return_declared_base_amount_fen=#{draft.returnLeg.base},outbound_declared_extra_amount_fen=#{draft.outbound.extra},return_declared_extra_amount_fen=#{draft.returnLeg.extra}, outbound_declared_total_amount_fen=#{draft.outbound.total},return_declared_total_amount_fen=#{draft.returnLeg.total},declared_total_amount_fen=#{draft.total},extra_fee_detail_json=#{draft.details}, evidence_count=#{draft.count},updated_at=#{draft.at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{draft.id} AND rental_order_id=#{draft.orderId} AND version=#{draft.version} AND review_status='draft'

UPDATE order_transport_expense_statement SET review_status='submitted',extra_fee_detail_json=#{details},submitted_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND review_status='draft'

UPDATE order_transport_expense_statement SET review_status=IF(#{approve},'approved','returned'),review_user_id=#{actor},review_reason=#{reason}, reviewed_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 ,outbound_approved_amount_fen=outbound_declared_total_amount_fen,return_approved_amount_fen=return_declared_total_amount_fen, approved_total_amount_fen=declared_total_amount_fen,online_settle_amount_fen=LEAST(prepaid_pool_amount_fen,declared_total_amount_fen), over_budget_amount_fen=GREATEST(0,declared_total_amount_fen-prepaid_pool_amount_fen),refundable_amount_fen=GREATEST(0,prepaid_pool_amount_fen-declared_total_amount_fen) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND review_status IN ('submitted','reviewing')

UPDATE rental_order_freight_account SET outbound_approved_amount_fen=#{row.approvedOutbound},return_approved_amount_fen=#{row.approvedReturn}, approved_total_amount_fen=#{row.approvedTotal},online_settle_amount_fen=#{row.online},over_budget_amount_fen=#{row.overBudget},refundable_amount_fen=#{row.refundable}-refunded_amount_fen, freight_status=IF(refundable_amount_fen=0,'settled','refunding'),settled_at=IF(refundable_amount_fen=0,#{at},NULL),version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE rental_order_id=#{row.orderId} AND initial_prepaid_amount_fen=#{row.pool} AND refunded_amount_fen<=#{row.refundable} AND freight_status IN ('prepaid','reviewing')
